acceptance: The reference vector scores exactly 1,000 within declared rounding, and scaling every candidate atomic performance value by x scales the headline by x.
Query order and duplicated enumeration do not change the score because leaf and lineage weights are explicit.
Only passed required evidence is admitted; any missing, skipped, timed-out, cancelled, translation-failed, or incorrect atom invalidates its block and headline without redistributing weight.
Power atoms are per-query measurements and Throughput atoms are complete workload-family batches; every block requires all of its frozen atoms.
A proportional alternative reference preserves candidate ordering, while a non-proportional reference is rejected as non-equivalent.
Golden fixtures replay byte-for-byte equivalent scores and diagnostics and include positive and negative reference-equivalence cases.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Implement a pure calculator that consumes a frozen manifest, a matching reference vector, and admitted evidence. It must calculate atomic ratios, geometric block scores, and the 1,000-point headline without reading mutable registries or running benchmarks.
